design.mood: Technological, secure, and imposing; an 'industrial cyberpunk' aesthetic that emphasizes structural integrity and precision.
design.motion: Subtle parallax movement of the 3D cube background tied to mouse movement. Text elements should employ a 'staggered reveal' from bottom to top with a heavy easing function (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
design.centerpiece: A high-density 3D geometric grid of matte black extruded cubes with varying heights, creating a tactile, architectural backdrop.
guardrails: Avoid high-gloss or reflective surfaces on the 3D cubes; maintain a matte/industrial finish.
Do not use gradients in the typography except for the core accent green.
Avoid rounded corners on buttons; keep a 4px to 6px radius for a technical feel.
Do not use thin or light font weights for headlines; maintain a heavy, authoritative presence.

typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, monospace light for utility text/captions

design.layout: Full-bleed immersive hero with a top-aligned navigation bar featuring a boxed CTA. The text content is left-aligned in the lower-third, utilizing a vertical stack of headline, subheadline, and dual-action buttons.
